marketing.copy_heb_ik_een_echt_dartbord_: Do I need a physical dartboard?
marketing.copy_nee_dartspoint_is_een_dig: No. DartsPoint is a digital darts game. Set direction and height using two moving bars and the red throw button. Play with a mouse, keyboard or touchscreen.
marketing.copy_welke_spelvormen_kan_ik_s: Which game formats can I play?
marketing.copy_je_kunt_301_dubbel_in_dub: You can play 301 double-in/double-out, 501 and 701. For 501 and 701, you start without an opening double and finish on a double. When inviting someone, choose legs or sets and whether to play for the DP ranking.
marketing.copy_hoe_werkt_mijn_dp_rating: How does my DP rating work?
marketing.copy_je_begint_op_1500_het_res: You start at 1500. The result and your opponent’s rating determine how much you gain or lose. Casual play and practice do not count. Your rating is provisional until you have played at least ten ranked matches against five different opponents.
marketing.copy_wat_is_het_verschil_tusse: What is the difference between the ladder and divisions?
marketing.copy_de_dp_ladder_laat_de_spee: The DP ladder shows playing strength based on ranked matches. A division is a season competition with its own fixtures and standings. Competition points count there: three for a win, zero for a loss. At the end of the season, you can be promoted or relegated.
marketing.copy_kan_ik_toernooien_bekijke: Can I watch tournaments without playing?
marketing.copy_ja_elk_toernooi_heeft_een: Yes. Every tournament has its own room. Spectators can view fixtures and watch matches. If you register, you play the matches assigned to you.
marketing.copy_kan_ik_tegen_andere_spele: Can I play against other players?
marketing.copy_je_speelt_met_je_eigen_ac: You use your own account to play against other players. DartsPoint records throws, results, DP and competitions. Practice and casual matches do not change your DP.
